Minor 4 (no test pins the member-row truncate-and-title that AC-5 claims as verified) is real: AC-5 now names the new member-row unit case. Minor 5 (max-w-full on the back-link is inert; the label span does the work) is real: files[] now states the span is the fix and drops max-w-full. What the review and QA of PR #45 (for #34) found and did not fix there — filed as it merged, one ticket for the lot. ## From the review Non-blocking findings the reviewer approved despite: a statement about severity, not a judgement that they are wrong. ### Sibling notices that interpolate group/member names share BUG-1's exact shape: removedNoticeText(memberName, groupName) built at components/members-screen.tsx:131 renders in the plain

at components/groups-panels.tsx:716-722 (class rounded-token border border-border bg-lent-tint p-3 text-secondary text-lent, no break-words), and archivedNoticeText(group.name) at app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:273 renders in the plain

at lines 269-274 (no break-words). An 80-character unbroken group name (GROUP_NAME_MAX, lib/groups/validation.ts:21) in either would set the document width past the 375px viewport the same way the ?left= notice did. > Sibling notices that interpolate group/member names share BUG-1's exact shape: removedNoticeText(memberName, groupName) built at components/members-screen.tsx:131 renders in the plain

at components/groups-panels.tsx:716-722 (class rounded-token border border-border bg-lent-tint p-3 text-secondary text-lent, no break-words), and archivedNoticeText(group.name) at app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:273 renders in the plain

at lines 269-274 (no break-words). An 80-character unbroken group name (GROUP_NAME_MAX, lib/groups/validation.ts:21) in either would set the document width past the 375px viewport the same way the ?left= notice did. > > `components/groups-panels.tsx:718` > > Evidence: git show origin/sdlc/issue-34:components/groups-panels.tsx sed 716,724 and app/groups/[id]/page.tsx sed 267,274: both

carry no break-words/overflow-wrap class while interpolating group names; invite/expense notices are closed-set fixed strings (inviteNoticeText/expenseNoticeText) and are safe. Unproven live -- no 375px scrollWidth measurement exists for these two pages, and the work order carries them as a residual risk. > > Fix: Apply the same one-class break-words treatment to those two

elements with a matching unit case each; keep it a follow-up, not this ticket, per the work order's out-of-scope clause. ## Found by QA — pre-existing PR #45 did not introduce these, which is why they did not block it. ### Leave notice with a max-length group name scrolls the phone layout horizontally **Severity** minor (as judged by QA — reassess before planning). **Expected.** > The ?left= notice wraps within the viewport at 375px; no horizontal scroll **Actual.** > An 80-character unbroken group name (GROUP_NAME_MAX) in the notice pushes document scrollWidth to 753px at a 375px viewport **Steps to reproduce** 1. Sign up a fresh account 2. Open /?left=<80 x characters> (the value the leave flow redirects with for a max-length group name) 3. Set the viewport to 375px wide and read document.documentElement.scrollWidth — 753, the page scrolls sideways **Suspected cause.** > LeftGroupNotice (components/home-panels.tsx) renders the sentence in a plain

with no word-breaking; the pre-PR notice had the same unbroken markup, so the defect predates this diff — but this PR owns the component now and a break-words class fixes it. **Reproducible:** always --- **Check each one still reproduces before planning it.** They were written against the PR as it stood, and a later round can have fixed one. Some may not hold up: say so and drop them rather than implementing something that was never wrong. Split this if they turn out to be unrelated. Depends on #34. ## Decisions (recorded by the pipeline) - **replan** by @Shivam-Fl (2026-10-06T06:30:52.399Z): The implementer measured in a browser that adding break-words to the two notices cannot meet AC-1 or AC-2: at 375px the page is still 1136px wide, and the notices are never the widest element. What sets the width is the unbroken group name in the page headings: the h1 at app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:253 (wrapping it alone takes the group page from 1136 to 375) and the h1 at components/members-screen.tsx:75 plus the breadcrumbs at :66-72 and :160-167 on the members page. Plan the fix where the width comes from; the acceptance criteria stand.
